from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
for path in sorted(Path('.').glob('*.pdf')):
    data = subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo', path], text=True)
    assert re.search(r'"'^Pages:'"\\s+1"'$'"', data, re.M)
    assert not re.search(r'"'^(Author|Creator|Producer):'"', data, re.M)
    print(path, next(line for line in data.splitlines() if line.startswith('Page size')))
    copy = subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext', '-layout', path, '-'], text=True)
    if path.name.startswith('Child'):
        for phrase in ['Painted arch', 'Warehouse windows', 'Brick circle', 'Same repeat again', 'Draw it with what’s next to it.']:
            assert copy.count(phrase) == 2, (path, phrase)
    else:
        slots = [(int(a), int(b)) for a,b in re.findall(r'(\\d+)[–-](\\d+) min', copy)]
        assert slots == [(0, 5), (5, 11), (11, 16), (16, 22), (22, 28), (28, 30)], slots
        assert sum(int(d) for d in re.findall(r'Walk (\\d+) m', copy)) == 650
    subprocess.run(['gs', '-q', '-dPDFSTOPONERROR', '-dNOPAUSE', '-dBATCH', '-sDEVICE=nullpage', path], check=True)
